description: Search every LACCD course and program across all 9 colleges from your terminal — with cross-college comparison, prerequisite chains, and offline search the per-college web catalog can't do.

tools.name: colleges_list
tools.description: List the 9 LACCD colleges, their tenant codes, and catalog base URLs. Returns array of College.

tools.name: config_list
tools.description: List the public eLumen catalog configuration key/value pairs (review windows, presentation settings). Returns array of Configuration.

tools.name: courses_get
tools.description: Fetch a single course by its numeric catalog id, including the full course outline (units, hours, requisites, outcomes, objectives, description). Required: course_id. Returns the Course.

params.name: course_id
params.description: Numeric course id (the 'id' field from a search result, e.g. 40830).

tools.name: courses_search
tools.description: Search or browse approved courses across LACCD. Leave --query empty to browse a whole college (or all 9). Full-text matches course code, title, and description. Optional: query, status (default: approved), tenant (plus 3 more). Returns array of Course.

params.name: query
params.description: Search term matched against course code, title, and description (e.g. 'accounting', 'biology'). Optional — leave empty to browse the full catalog.

params.name: status
params.description: Course status filter (default 'approved' = the published public catalog).

params.name: tenant
params.description: Limit to one LACCD college by its eLumen tenant host, e.g. 'elac.elumenapp.com'. Run 'colleges list' for all 9 hosts. Omit to search the whole district.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number — 1-indexed. The first page is 1; page 0 triggers an upstream HTTP 502 (eLumen backend quirk).

tools.name: programs_get
tools.description: Fetch a single program by its numeric id, including award type, credit ranges, requirements, and SLOs. Required: program_id. Returns the Program.

params.name: program_id
params.description: Numeric program id (the 'id' field from a program search result, e.g. 255).

tools.name: programs_search
tools.description: Search or browse LACCD degree and certificate programs. Leave --query empty to browse a college's full program list. Full-text matches program name and description. Optional: query, status, tenant (plus 2 more). Returns array of Program.

params.name: query
params.description: Search term matched against program name and description (e.g. 'nursing', 'business'). Optional — leave empty to browse all programs.

params.name: status
params.description: Program status filter (e.g. approved). Optional — omit to search all statuses.

params.name: tenant
params.description: Limit to one LACCD college by its eLumen tenant host, e.g. 'pierce.elumenapp.com'. Run 'colleges list' for all 9 hosts. Omit to search the whole district.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number — 1-indexed. The first page is 1; page 0 triggers an upstream HTTP 502 (eLumen backend quirk).
